ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central and distal regions and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized along the trailing edges and proximal hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe exhibits a dominant white contiguous region extending from the mid-lobe to the tip, bounded by a thin black margin at the trailing edge. Left lobe displays a high-intensity white central patch with a wide black field extending toward the outer margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees; depth is partially occluded by water surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, irregular serrations (peaks < 5 pixels) observed along the right lobe trailing edge; the left lobe edge is obscured by an inward 3D curl/fold.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe displays a concave trailing edge trajectory transitioning into a sharp distal tip; the left lobe displays a forced convex profile due to structural curling.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast tan and white textured clusters (barnacle colonies) localized on the distal tips of both lobes and along the leading edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiotic colonization (barnacles) creating significant topographical protrusion on both distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant mechanical folding/curling of the left fluke lobe toward the ventral plane, obscuring a portion of its surface area.
